messages:
Marta L: Heads-up — Verdigris Health private cutover is tentatively scheduled for Fri 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. We were planning to pin runtime to v2.8.1 and the customer has a KMS key rotation slated for 02:15 UTC. Anyone see a conflict or objections?

Tanvi R: @Marta L that KMS rotation during cutover is risky. We normally ask customers to delay KMS rotations 24h around a cutover. If rotation happens mid-deploy we could see auth failures.

Samir P: We have two choices: shift their KMS rotation to after our cutover (preferred) or pin to a compatibility build (v2.8.0-compat) that tolerates old key material. Changing pin needs a quick canary.

Priya K: Ops note — changing the pin expands the runbook: add canary window + smoke tests. That will consume burst capacity. Do we have margin in the Dedicated pool at that hour?

Alex H: Customer SE said their preferred maintenance window is 04:00–06:00 UTC. If we move cutover to 04:00 we avoid the KMS rotation conflict and give us daylight for troubleshooting. Recommend move.

Marta L: Reached out to the Verdigris SE — they can shift KMS rotation if we confirm a new cutover. They prefer we control timing. Tentative new cutover: 2026-04-02 04:00 UTC. Priya, can you update runbook and add rollback thresholds?

Priya K: Will update. Proposed rollback triggers: sustained error rate >2.5% for 5m OR p95 latency increase >1.2s over baseline for 5m. Rollback action: revert to v2.7.9, rebind KMS ARN, and restart worker slices. I'll also add smoke checks: GET /health, POST /embed quick sample, and auth handshake validation.

Tanvi R: Add one more: ensure KVCACHE warmup survives the revert. For the canary set --preserve-kvcache=false to avoid stale state during validation.

Samir P: I'll prep the rollback script and be on-call for the window: `scripts/rollback_verdigris.sh` — it reverts model pin, restores kms mapping, and drains slices.

DeployBot: dry-run: OK on staging for v2.8.1. Canary plan: 10% for 20m, then ramp to 100% with 5m step. Deploy queued by @Marta L for 2026-04-02T04:00:00Z.

Marta L: Thanks. Jordan (release), can you sign off so we can confirm with the customer?

Jordan R: Reviewed runbook and rollback criteria. Signoff from release: ✅ Move to 04:00 UTC. Make sure on-call rota includes Samir, Priya, and Tanvi.

Priya K: Signed off. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/verdigris-cutover — includes thresholds, rollback steps, and postmortem checklist.

Alex H: Customer SE confirmed and updated their KMS rotation to 05:00 UTC to be safe.

DeployBot: deploy started — canary 10% (4 nodes). Will post metric updates every 5m.

DeployBot: canary metrics @+10m: error_rate=0.12%, p95=175ms, auth_failures=0.

Samir P: Metrics look good from my side. Preparing ramp to 100% in 5m.

DeployBot: ramping. 100% traffic routed.

DeployBot: final metrics: error_rate=0.09%, p95=190ms, kvcache_warm=false (expected), auth_handshake=OK.

Marta L: Great work — closing thread. If anything anomalous appears, reopen or ping the rollout channel. :rocket:
